# Purpose-built AI. For the _financial moments_ that matter

numa is nudge’s AI. Built from a decade of local financial expertise, governed to enterprise standards, and proven across the platform every day. The intelligence behind every action plan, proactive nudge, and personalized experience.

[get a demo](https://www.hello-nudge.com/platform/powered-by-ai#) [Explore ai governance](https://www.hello-nudge.com/platform/trust-security)

## TRUSTED BY THE WORLD'S LEADING EMPLOYERS

why we're different

## AI built for financial decisions

General-purpose AI can answer a financial question. numa changes financial behavior. That distinction comes from over a decade of localized financial expertise, a deterministic intelligence layer, and an AI governance framework that sets the standard for our industry.

### Grounded in expert knowledge, not the open web

numa draws only from nudge's proprietary expertise. Over 10,000 structured, validated knowledge assets localized across 160 markets, and built and maintained by in-house personal finance experts. Unlike probabilistic general-purpose AI, numa's outputs are deterministic: consistent, auditable, and grounded in guidance your employees can trust.

### Governed to the highest standard in the industry

nudge® is ISO 42001 accredited for responsible AI management. One of the first organizations in the world to achieve this. That governance infrastructure covers the full lifecycle: design, deployment, bias testing, human oversight, and a complete audit trail for every interaction. For enterprise buyers, that's not a nice-to-have. It's a prerequisite.

### Built to change behavior, not just answer questions

Engagement with nudge's AI-powered platform runs at over 60% across the client base. That's the result of proactive, personalized, and contextually relevant guidance, not a chatbot waiting to be opened. numa is built on behavioral science principles that move employees from financial awareness to financial action.

## Have questions? Find answers

What is numa?

numa is nudge's AI: the intelligence layer that powers personalization across the entire platform. It builds each employee's financial action plan, identifies the right moment to reach out with a proactive nudge, and is available directly for in-the-moment financial questions. It's not a standalone tool. It's what makes the nudge platform personal.

Why shouldn't we just use a general-purpose AI tool for this?

General-purpose AI can answer a financial question. numa is built to change financial behavior. At enterprise scale, across 160 markets, with the consistency, governance, and impartiality that financial guidance demands. General-purpose AI is probabilistic: the same question can produce a different answer each time. numa is deterministic: consistent, auditable, and grounded in nudge's expert-validated content library. And unlike general-purpose tools, it carries no GDPR risk and generates a full audit trail for every interaction.

Does numa provide financial advice?

No. nudge's philosophy is "educate, empower, never prescribe." numa provides impartial financial guidance. Helping employees understand their options and build the confidence to act. It does not recommend specific financial products, tell employees what to do, or provide regulated financial advice. If an employee needs product-specific or regulated guidance, numa will signpost them to find a licensed advisor.

How does nudge ensure the AI is accurate across different countries?

Every market nudge operates in goes through a detailed review before numa is deployed there, covering country-specific financial content sufficiency, localized guardrails, language accuracy, and cultural fit. numa draws only from nudge's proprietary content library, built and maintained by in-house personal finance experts with country-specific knowledge. Financial systems, tax law, and benefits frameworks vary significantly by country. We review each one separately, so your employees get impartial guidance that's locally accurate, not globally averaged.

What AI governance standards does nudge meet?

nudge holds ISO 42001 accreditation for responsible AI management. One of the first organizations globally to achieve this, alongside long-standing ISO 27001 information security certification. Every AI feature undergoes an AI System Impact Assessment before deployment, and all interactions generate a full audit trail. We align with ISO 27001, ISO 42001, the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, the OECD AI Principles, and EU AI Act requirements. Further detail is available on our [**_Trust and Security_** page](https://www.hello-nudge.com/platform/trust-security).
